feature: Money path — successful recurring renewal (MSP platform subscription). invoice.payment_succeeded on an already-active subscription keeps it active, leaves dunning untouched, and does NOT spuriously fire the dunning-cleared recovery branch.
notes: Epic #803 (Money-path lifecycle coverage) — the post-purchase transition money-path-e2e.json does not reach. Drives the REAL msp-billing-webhook handlePaymentSucceeded via the dev-origin-gated POST /api/admin/testbed/billing-simulate (same dispatchMspStripeEvent the production /api/msp/stripe/webhook route calls). See payment-failed-dunning.json notes for the full honest-boundary explanation (signature verification + Stripe event emission are the only skipped parts).

The distinctive assertion here: handlePaymentSucceeded only emits an msp.subscription.dunning_cleared event + restores the MSP when the subscription WAS in dunning. On a plain healthy renewal (no prior failure) that branch must NOT fire — asserted as rowCount 0 — so a regression that eagerly clears/restores on every renewal would be caught.
PRECONDITION / Shane To-Do: POST /api/admin/testbed/billing-simulate must be deployed; run against a .replit.dev dev origin. Not run from this authoring environment. ENV VARS: DEPLOY_URL, SECRET_KEY.

apiTests.name: SETUP — testbed MSP subscription at clean active baseline
EXECUTE — invoice.payment_succeeded (normal monthly renewal) through the real dispatcher
VERIFY — subscription remains active after the renewal

body.query: SELECT status FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — dunning_state stays NULL on a healthy renewal

body.query: SELECT (dunning_state IS NULL) AS dunning_clear FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — payment_failed_at stays NULL on a healthy renewal

body.query: SELECT (payment_failed_at IS NULL) AS failed_clear FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — the dunning-cleared recovery branch did NOT fire (no such event) on a plain renewal

body.query: SELECT e.id FROM msp_event_store e JOIN msp_subscriptions s ON s.msp_id = e.msp_id WHERE s.stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed' AND e.event_type = 'msp.subscription.dunning_cleared'
